1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.Accounting.LegacyBookingBackfill do
2	  @moduledoc """
3	  One-off backfill for journal entries that predate booking at posting time and
4	  are still missing a category or a need/want choice.
5	
6	  An entry is completed only when the same user's posted entries from the same
7	  issuer (compared like the duplicate index, trimmed and case-insensitive) agree
8	  on every missing value. Values the entry already has are kept. Anything else
9	  is reported for a person to book, so nothing is guessed from a similar name.
10	
11	  Bookings a person already decided are passed at run time as `:manual`, so no
12	  real ledger data lives in the repository. They are keyed by entry ID and
13	  normalized issuer so they cannot land on another row, and go through
14	  `Accounting.post_entry/6`, exactly like the invoice page's Book form.
15	
16	  It is a dry run unless called with `confirm: true`. Each entry is updated in
17	  its own transaction together with a `journal_entry_posted` event marked with
18	  `source: "legacy_booking_backfill"` that records the prior state. For those copied bookings, tax claims and notes
19	  are left alone, and `updated_at` is kept so old entries do not jump to the top
20	  of the journal.
21	  """
22	
23	  import Ecto.Query, warn: false
24	
25	  alias Ecto.Multi
26	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting
27	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.JournalEntry
28	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.TaxDeductionClaim
29	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
30	  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
31	  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.ReviewDecision
32	
33	  @source "legacy_booking_backfill"
34	
35	  @type match :: %{
36	          required(:entry) => JournalEntry.t(),
37	          required(:document_id) => integer(),
38	          required(:category) => String.t(),
39	          required(:need_or_want) => String.t(),
40	          required(:source) => :precedent | :manual,
41	          optional(:precedent_count) => pos_integer(),
42	          optional(:tax_status) => String.t() | nil
43	        }
44	
45	  @type unmatched :: %{
46	          entry: JournalEntry.t(),
47	          document_id: integer(),
48	          reason: :no_history | :conflicting_history
49	        }
50	
51	  @type summary :: %{
52	          confirmed: boolean(),
53	          matched: [match()],
54	          applied: [match()],
55	          unmatched: [unmatched()],
56	          failed: [%{match: match(), errors: term()}]
57	        }
58	
59	  @doc """
60	  Plans the backfill and, with `confirm: true`, applies it.
61	
62	  Returns `{:error, summary}` only when an update failed. Unmatched entries are
63	  expected and left for manual booking.
64	
65	  Options:
66	
67	    * `:confirm` - apply the plan instead of only reporting it.
68	    * `:manual` - decided bookings as a map of `{entry_id, normalized_issuer}`
69	      to `%{category: _, need_or_want: _, tax_status: _}`. Defaults to none.
70	  """
71	  @spec run(keyword()) :: {:ok, summary()} | {:error, summary()}
72	  def run(opts \\ []) do
73	    confirmed = Keyword.get(opts, :confirm, false)
74	    %{matched: matched, unmatched: unmatched} = plan(Keyword.get(opts, :manual, %{}))
75	    %{applied: applied, failed: failed} = apply_matches(matched, confirmed)
76	
77	    summary = %{
78	      confirmed: confirmed,
79	      matched: matched,
80	      applied: applied,
81	      unmatched: unmatched,
82	      failed: failed
83	    }
84	
85	    {if(failed == [], do: :ok, else: :error), summary}
86	  end
87	
88	  @spec format_summary(summary()) :: String.t()
89	  def format_summary(summary) do
90	    verb = if summary.confirmed, do: "Booked", else: "Would book"
91	    mode = if summary.confirmed, do: "applied", else: "dry run"
92	
93	    [
94	      "Legacy booking backfill (#{mode}): matched=#{length(summary.matched)} " <>
95	        "applied=#{length(summary.applied)} unmatched=#{length(summary.unmatched)} " <>
96	        "failed=#{length(summary.failed)}",
97	      Enum.map(summary.matched, &format_match(&1, verb)),
98	      Enum.map(summary.unmatched, &format_unmatched/1),
99	      Enum.map(summary.failed, &format_failure/1),
100	      if(summary.confirmed, do: [], else: "Nothing changed. Re-run with confirm: true to apply.")
101	    ]
102	    |> List.flatten()
103	    |> Enum.join("\n")
104	  end
105	
106	  defp plan(manual) do
107	    precedents = precedents()
108	
109	    targets()
110	    |> Enum.map(&classify(&1, precedents, manual))
111	    |> Enum.group_by(&elem(&1, 0), &elem(&1, 1))
112	    |> then(&%{matched: Map.get(&1, :matched, []), unmatched: Map.get(&1, :unmatched, [])})
113	  end
114	
115	  defp targets do
116	    Repo.all(
117	      from e in JournalEntry,
118	        join: d in ReviewDecision,
119	        on: d.id == e.review_decision_id,
120	        join: c in ExtractedContent,
121	        on: c.id == d.extracted_content_id,
122	        left_join: t in TaxDeductionClaim,
123	        on: t.journal_entry_id == e.id,
124	        where: is_nil(e.category) or is_nil(e.need_or_want),
125	        order_by: e.id,
126	        select: %{
127	          entry: e,
128	          document_id: c.document_id,
129	          tax_status: t.status,
130	          issuer_key: fragment("lower(btrim(?))", e.issuer)
131	        }
132	    )
133	  end
134	
135	  defp precedents do
136	    from(e in JournalEntry,
137	      where: e.status == "posted",
138	      where: not is_nil(e.category) and not is_nil(e.need_or_want),
139	      where: fragment("btrim(?) <> ''", e.issuer),
140	      group_by: [e.user_id, fragment("lower(btrim(?))", e.issuer), e.category, e.need_or_want],
141	      select: %{
142	        user_id: e.user_id,
143	        issuer_key: fragment("lower(btrim(?))", e.issuer),
144	        category: e.category,
145	        need_or_want: e.need_or_want,
146	        count: count(e.id)
147	      }
148	    )
149	    |> Repo.all()
150	    |> Enum.group_by(&{&1.user_id, &1.issuer_key})
151	  end
152	
153	  defp classify(%{entry: entry, issuer_key: issuer_key} = target, precedents, manual) do
154	    row = Map.take(target, [:entry, :document_id, :tax_status])
155	
156	    case Map.fetch(manual, {entry.id, issuer_key}) do
157	      {:ok, decision} -> {:matched, row |> Map.merge(decision) |> Map.put(:source, :manual)}
158	      :error -> classify_from_history(row, Map.get(precedents, {entry.user_id, issuer_key}, []))
159	    end
160	  end
161	
162	  defp classify_from_history(%{entry: entry} = row, history) do
163	    case history |> Enum.map(&completed_booking(entry, &1)) |> Enum.uniq() do
164	      [] ->
165	        {:unmatched, Map.put(row, :reason, :no_history)}
166	
167	      [{category, need_or_want}] ->
168	        precedent_count = history |> Enum.map(& &1.count) |> Enum.sum()
169	
170	        {:matched,
171	         Map.merge(row, %{
172	           category: category,
173	           need_or_want: need_or_want,
174	           precedent_count: precedent_count,
175	           source: :precedent
176	         })}
177	
178	      _conflicting ->
179	        {:unmatched, Map.put(row, :reason, :conflicting_history)}
180	    end
181	  end
182	
183	  # Precedents only need to agree on what the entry is missing.
184	  defp completed_booking(entry, precedent) do
185	    {entry.category || precedent.category, entry.need_or_want || precedent.need_or_want}
186	  end
187	
188	  defp apply_matches(_matched, false), do: %{applied: [], failed: []}
189	
190	  defp apply_matches(matched, true) do
191	    results = Enum.map(matched, &{&1, apply_match(&1)})
192	
193	    %{
194	      applied: for({match, {:ok, _}} <- results, do: match),
195	      failed:
196	        for({match, {:error, changeset}} <- results) do
197	          %{match: match, errors: changeset.errors}
198	        end
199	    }
200	  end
201

defmodule ZaimuTomo.Accounting.LegacyBookingBackfill do
  @moduledoc """
  One-off backfill for journal entries that predate booking at posting time and
  are still missing a category or a need/want choice.

  An entry is completed only when the same user's posted entries from the same
  issuer (compared like the duplicate index, trimmed and case-insensitive) agree
  on every missing value. Values the entry already has are kept. Anything else
  is reported for a person to book, so nothing is guessed from a similar name.

  Bookings a person already decided are passed at run time as `:manual`, so no
  real ledger data lives in the repository. They are keyed by entry ID and
  normalized issuer so they cannot land on another row, and go through
  `Accounting.post_entry/6`, exactly like the invoice page's Book form.

  It is a dry run unless called with `confirm: true`. Each entry is updated in
  its own transaction together with a `journal_entry_posted` event marked with
  `source: "legacy_booking_backfill"` that records the prior state. For those copied bookings, tax claims and notes
  are left alone, and `updated_at` is kept so old entries do not jump to the top
  of the journal.
  """

  import Ecto.Query, warn: false

  alias Ecto.Multi
  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting
  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.JournalEntry
  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.TaxDeductionClaim
  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.ReviewDecision

  @source "legacy_booking_backfill"

  @type match :: %{
          required(:entry) => JournalEntry.t(),
          required(:document_id) => integer(),
          required(:category) => String.t(),
          required(:need_or_want) => String.t(),
          required(:source) => :precedent | :manual,
          optional(:precedent_count) => pos_integer(),
          optional(:tax_status) => String.t() | nil
        }

  @type unmatched :: %{
          entry: JournalEntry.t(),
          document_id: integer(),
          reason: :no_history | :conflicting_history
        }

  @type summary :: %{
          confirmed: boolean(),
          matched: [match()],
          applied: [match()],
          unmatched: [unmatched()],
          failed: [%{match: match(), errors: term()}]
        }

  @doc """
  Plans the backfill and, with `confirm: true`, applies it.

  Returns `{:error, summary}` only when an update failed. Unmatched entries are
  expected and left for manual booking.

  Options:

    * `:confirm` - apply the plan instead of only reporting it.
    * `:manual` - decided bookings as a map of `{entry_id, normalized_issuer}`
      to `%{category: _, need_or_want: _, tax_status: _}`. Defaults to none.
  """
  @spec run(keyword()) :: {:ok, summary()} | {:error, summary()}
  def run(opts \\ []) do
    confirmed = Keyword.get(opts, :confirm, false)
    %{matched: matched, unmatched: unmatched} = plan(Keyword.get(opts, :manual, %{}))
    %{applied: applied, failed: failed} = apply_matches(matched, confirmed)

    summary = %{
      confirmed: confirmed,
      matched: matched,
      applied: applied,
      unmatched: unmatched,
      failed: failed
    }

    {if(failed == [], do: :ok, else: :error), summary}
  end

  @spec format_summary(summary()) :: String.t()
  def format_summary(summary) do
    verb = if summary.confirmed, do: "Booked", else: "Would book"
    mode = if summary.confirmed, do: "applied", else: "dry run"

    [
      "Legacy booking backfill (#{mode}): matched=#{length(summary.matched)} " <>
        "applied=#{length(summary.applied)} unmatched=#{length(summary.unmatched)} " <>
        "failed=#{length(summary.failed)}",
      Enum.map(summary.matched, &format_match(&1, verb)),
      Enum.map(summary.unmatched, &format_unmatched/1),
      Enum.map(summary.failed, &format_failure/1),
      if(summary.confirmed, do: [], else: "Nothing changed. Re-run with confirm: true to apply.")
    ]
    |> List.flatten()
    |> Enum.join("\n")
  end

  defp plan(manual) do
    precedents = precedents()

    targets()
    |> Enum.map(&classify(&1, precedents, manual))
    |> Enum.group_by(&elem(&1, 0), &elem(&1, 1))
    |> then(&%{matched: Map.get(&1, :matched, []), unmatched: Map.get(&1, :unmatched, [])})
  end

  defp targets do
    Repo.all(
      from e in JournalEntry,
        join: d in ReviewDecision,
        on: d.id == e.review_decision_id,
        join: c in ExtractedContent,
        on: c.id == d.extracted_content_id,
        left_join: t in TaxDeductionClaim,
        on: t.journal_entry_id == e.id,
        where: is_nil(e.category) or is_nil(e.need_or_want),
        order_by: e.id,
        select: %{
          entry: e,
          document_id: c.document_id,
          tax_status: t.status,
          issuer_key: fragment("lower(btrim(?))", e.issuer)
        }
    )
  end

  defp precedents do
    from(e in JournalEntry,
      where: e.status == "posted",
      where: not is_nil(e.category) and not is_nil(e.need_or_want),
      where: fragment("btrim(?) <> ''", e.issuer),
      group_by: [e.user_id, fragment("lower(btrim(?))", e.issuer), e.category, e.need_or_want],
      select: %{
        user_id: e.user_id,
        issuer_key: fragment("lower(btrim(?))", e.issuer),
        category: e.category,
        need_or_want: e.need_or_want,
        count: count(e.id)
      }
    )
    |> Repo.all()
    |> Enum.group_by(&{&1.user_id, &1.issuer_key})
  end

  defp classify(%{entry: entry, issuer_key: issuer_key} = target, precedents, manual) do
    row = Map.take(target, [:entry, :document_id, :tax_status])

    case Map.fetch(manual, {entry.id, issuer_key}) do
      {:ok, decision} -> {:matched, row |> Map.merge(decision) |> Map.put(:source, :manual)}
      :error -> classify_from_history(row, Map.get(precedents, {entry.user_id, issuer_key}, []))
    end
  end

  defp classify_from_history(%{entry: entry} = row, history) do
    case history |> Enum.map(&completed_booking(entry, &1)) |> Enum.uniq() do
      [] ->
        {:unmatched, Map.put(row, :reason, :no_history)}

      [{category, need_or_want}] ->
        precedent_count = history |> Enum.map(& &1.count) |> Enum.sum()

        {:matched,
         Map.merge(row, %{
           category: category,
           need_or_want: need_or_want,
           precedent_count: precedent_count,
           source: :precedent
         })}

      _conflicting ->
        {:unmatched, Map.put(row, :reason, :conflicting_history)}
    end
  end

  # Precedents only need to agree on what the entry is missing.
  defp completed_booking(entry, precedent) do
    {entry.category || precedent.category, entry.need_or_want || precedent.need_or_want}
  end

  defp apply_matches(_matched, false), do: %{applied: [], failed: []}

  defp apply_matches(matched, true) do
    results = Enum.map(matched, &{&1, apply_match(&1)})

    %{
      applied: for({match, {:ok, _}} <- results, do: match),
      failed:
        for({match, {:error, changeset}} <- results) do
          %{match: match, errors: changeset.errors}
        end
    }
  end

  defp apply_match(%{source: :manual, entry: entry} = match) do
    Accounting.post_entry(
      entry,
      entry.user_id,
      match.category,
      match.need_or_want,
      entry.notes,
      %{"status" => match.tax_status}
    )
  end

  defp apply_match(%{source: :precedent} = match) do
    Multi.new()
    |> Multi.update(:entry, booking_changeset(match))
    |> Multi.insert(:event, &event_changeset(&1.entry, match))
    |> Repo.transaction()
    |> case do
      {:ok, changes} -> {:ok, changes}
      {:error, _step, changeset, _changes} -> {:error, changeset}
    end
  end

  defp booking_changeset(%{entry: entry} = match) do
    entry
    |> JournalEntry.changeset_for_categorize(%{
      category: match.category,
      need_or_want: match.need_or_want,
      status: "posted"
    })
    |> Ecto.Changeset.force_change(:updated_at, entry.updated_at)
  end

  defp event_changeset(booked_entry, %{entry: previous} = match) do
    Accounting.posted_event_changeset(booked_entry, match.tax_status, %{
      source: @source,
      precedent_count: match.precedent_count,
      previous_status: previous.status,
      previous_category: previous.category,
      previous_need_or_want: previous.need_or_want
    })
  end

  defp format_match(%{entry: entry} = match, verb) do
    "#{verb} entry #{entry.id} (#{entry.issuer}) as #{match.category} / #{match.need_or_want} " <>
      match_origin(match) <> "."
  end

  defp match_origin(%{source: :manual, tax_status: tax_status}),
    do: "from a manual decision, tax status #{tax_status}"

  defp match_origin(%{source: :precedent, precedent_count: count}),
    do: "from #{count} earlier posting(s)"

  defp format_unmatched(%{entry: entry, document_id: document_id, reason: reason}) do
    "Book by hand: entry #{entry.id} (#{entry.issuer}) at /documents/#{document_id}: " <>
      unmatched_reason(reason) <> "."
  end

  defp unmatched_reason(:no_history), do: "no earlier posting from this issuer"
  defp unmatched_reason(:conflicting_history), do: "earlier postings disagree"

  defp format_failure(%{match: %{entry: entry}, errors: errors}) do
    "Failed entry #{entry.id}: #{inspect(errors)}"
  end
end

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.Documents.FingerprintBackfill do
2	  @moduledoc """
3	  Idempotent, online backfill of exact-byte fingerprints for rows created
4	  before fingerprints existed.
5	
6	  1. Every document with a null `content_sha256` is read through
7	     `ZaimuTomo.Storage` and hashed. A missing or unreadable object is
8	     reported and left null; no other value is ever stored in its place.
9	  2. Every journal entry with a null `source_document_sha256` receives its
10	     source document's fingerprint, one entry per update and oldest first, so
11	     the first posting of a file keeps it. A unique-index violation (a same-user
12	     historical duplicate) affects only that row: it is reported with the entry
13	     it collides with and left null. Ledger rows are never deleted or merged.
14	
15	  A human may resolve a reported collision by listing the later entry in
16	  `:confirm_reuse`; the backfill then sets its digest and
17	  `source_file_reuse_confirmed` in one update. This is the only permitted
18	  update of an existing entry's fingerprint (spec D7), so it must run before
19	  any database-level immutability trigger on `journal_entries` exists, or that
20	  trigger must allow it.
21	
22	  The report contains row IDs and counts only, never bytes or digests. The
23	  partial unique index already exists, so concurrent postings cannot create a
24	  same-user duplicate while this runs.
25	  """
26	
27	  import Ecto.Query, warn: false
28	
29	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.JournalEntry
30	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
31	  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Document
32	  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Fingerprint
33	  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
34	  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.ReviewDecision
35	  alias ZaimuTomo.Storage
36	
37	  @type collision :: %{journal_entry_id: integer(), user_id: integer(), conflicts_with: integer()}
38	
39	  @type summary :: %{
40	          documents_hashed: non_neg_integer(),
41	          documents_already_complete: non_neg_integer(),
42	          missing_objects: [integer()],
43	          read_failures: [%{document_id: integer(), reason: term()}],
44	          entries_updated: non_neg_integer(),
45	          entries_already_complete: non_neg_integer(),
46	          entries_reuse_confirmed: [integer()],
47	          entries_source_unavailable: [integer()],
48	          collisions: [collision()],
49	          unused_reuse_confirmations: [integer()]
50	        }
51	
52	  @doc """
53	  Runs the backfill.
54	
55	  Returns `{:ok, summary}` when historical coverage is complete, and
56	  `{:error, summary}` when any object is missing or unreadable, an entry's
57	  source fingerprint is unavailable, or a collision awaits human review.
58	
59	  Options:
60	
61	    * `:confirm_reuse` — journal entry IDs a human confirmed as legitimate
62	      reuses of an already posted file. Applied only to an entry whose plain
63	      update collides; otherwise reported as unused.
64	  """
65	  @spec run(keyword()) :: {:ok, summary()} | {:error, summary()}
66	  def run(opts \\ []) do
67	    confirm_reuse = opts |> Keyword.get(:confirm_reuse, []) |> MapSet.new()
68	
69	    summary =
70	      empty_summary()
71	      |> backfill_documents()
72	      |> backfill_journal_entries(confirm_reuse)
73	      |> finalize(confirm_reuse)
74	
75	    if complete?(summary), do: {:ok, summary}, else: {:error, summary}
76	  end
77	
78	  @spec format_summary(summary()) :: String.t()
79	  def format_summary(summary) do
80	    [
81	      "Fingerprint backfill summary: " <>
82	        "documents_hashed=#{summary.documents_hashed} " <>
83	        "documents_already_complete=#{summary.documents_already_complete} " <>
84	        "missing_objects=#{length(summary.missing_objects)} " <>
85	        "read_failures=#{length(summary.read_failures)} " <>
86	        "entries_updated=#{summary.entries_updated} " <>
87	        "entries_already_complete=#{summary.entries_already_complete} " <>
88	        "entries_reuse_confirmed=#{length(summary.entries_reuse_confirmed)} " <>
89	        "entries_source_unavailable=#{length(summary.entries_source_unavailable)} " <>
90	        "collisions=#{length(summary.collisions)}"
91	      | Enum.map(summary.missing_objects, &"Missing object for document #{&1}") ++
92	          Enum.map(summary.read_failures, &format_read_failure/1) ++
93	          Enum.map(summary.entries_source_unavailable, &format_source_unavailable/1) ++
94	          Enum.map(summary.collisions, &format_collision/1) ++
95	          Enum.map(summary.entries_reuse_confirmed, &"Confirmed reuse for journal entry #{&1}") ++
96	          Enum.map(summary.unused_reuse_confirmations, &format_unused_confirmation/1) ++
97	          coverage_line(summary)
98	    ]
99	    |> Enum.join("\n")
100	  end
101	
102	  # -- Documents ---------------------------------------------------------------
103	
104	  defp backfill_documents(summary) do
105	    already_complete =
106	      Repo.aggregate(from(d in Document, where: not is_nil(d.content_sha256)), :count)
107	
108	    from(d in Document,
109	      where: is_nil(d.content_sha256),
110	      order_by: [asc: d.id],
111	      select: {d.id, d.object_key}
112	    )
113	    |> Repo.all()
114	    |> Enum.reduce(%{summary | documents_already_complete: already_complete}, &hash_document/2)
115	  end
116	
117	  defp hash_document({document_id, object_key}, summary) do
118	    case Storage.read_object(object_key) do
119	      {:ok, body} ->
120	        # Conditional on the same key and a still-null digest, so a concurrent
121	        # file replacement (which records its own digest) is never overwritten.
122	        {count, _} =
123	          from(d in Document,
124	            where:
125	              d.id == ^document_id and d.object_key == ^object_key and
126	                is_nil(d.content_sha256)
127	          )
128	          |> Repo.update_all(set: [content_sha256: Fingerprint.sha256(body)])
129	
130	        if count == 1,
131	          do: %{summary | documents_hashed: summary.documents_hashed + 1},
132	          else: %{summary | documents_already_complete: summary.documents_already_complete + 1}
133	
134	      {:error, :not_found} ->
135	        %{summary | missing_objects: [document_id | summary.missing_objects]}
136	
137	      {:error, reason} ->
138	        failure = %{document_id: document_id, reason: reason}
139	        %{summary | read_failures: [failure | summary.read_failures]}
140	    end
141	  end
142	
143	  # -- Journal entries ---------------------------------------------------------
144	
145	  defp backfill_journal_entries(summary, confirm_reuse) do
146	    already_complete =
147	      Repo.aggregate(
148	        from(je in JournalEntry, where: not is_nil(je.source_document_sha256)),
149	        :count
150	      )
151	
152	    from(je in JournalEntry,
153	      left_join: rd in ReviewDecision,
154	      on: rd.id == je.review_decision_id,
155	      left_join: ec in ExtractedContent,
156	      on: ec.id == rd.extracted_content_id and ec.user_id == je.user_id,
157	      left_join: d in Document,
158	      on: d.id == ec.document_id and d.user_id == je.user_id,
159	      where: is_nil(je.source_document_sha256),
160	      order_by: [asc: je.inserted_at, asc: je.id],
161	      select: {je, d.content_sha256}
162	    )
163	    |> Repo.all()
164	    |> Enum.reduce(
165	      %{summary | entries_already_complete: already_complete},
166	      &backfill_entry(&1, &2, confirm_reuse)
167	    )
168	  end
169	
170	  defp backfill_entry({entry, nil}, summary, _confirm_reuse) do
171	    %{summary | entries_source_unavailable: [entry.id | summary.entries_source_unavailable]}
172	  end
173	
174	  defp backfill_entry({entry, digest}, summary, confirm_reuse) do
175	    case update_entry(entry, %{source_document_sha256: digest}) do
176	      {:ok, _entry} ->
177	        %{summary | entries_updated: summary.entries_updated + 1}
178	
179	      {:error, :collision} ->
180	        if MapSet.member?(confirm_reuse, entry.id) do
181	          confirm_reuse(entry, digest, summary)
182	        else
183	          collision = %{
184	            journal_entry_id: entry.id,
185	            user_id: entry.user_id,
186	            conflicts_with: conflicting_entry_id(entry.user_id, digest)
187	          }
188	
189	          %{summary | collisions: [collision | summary.collisions]}
190	        end
191	    end
192	  end
193	
194	  defp confirm_reuse(entry, digest, summary) do
195	    attrs = %{source_document_sha256: digest, source_file_reuse_confirmed: true}
196	
197	    # A confirmed reuse is outside the partial index, so it cannot collide.
198	    {:ok, _entry} = update_entry(entry, attrs)
199	    %{summary | entries_reuse_confirmed: [entry.id | summary.entries_reuse_confirmed]}
200	  end
201	
202	  # The fingerprint is derived metadata, not an edit: keep `updated_at`, which
203	  # orders the user's journal list.
204	  defp update_entry(entry, attrs) do
205	    entry
206	    |> JournalEntry.changeset_for_fingerprint_backfill(attrs)
207	    |> Ecto.Changeset.force_change(:updated_at, entry.updated_at)
208	    |> Repo.update()
209	    |> case do
210	      {:ok, entry} ->
211	        {:ok, entry}
212	
213	      {:error, %Ecto.Changeset{} = changeset} ->
214	        if source_file_collision?(changeset),
215	          do: {:error, :collision},
216	          else: raise(Ecto.InvalidChangesetError, action: :update, changeset: changeset)
217	    end
218	  end
219	
220	  defp source_file_collision?(%Ecto.Changeset{errors: errors}) do
221	    Enum.any?(errors, fn {_field, {_message, opts}} ->
222	      opts[:constraint] == :unique and
223	        opts[:constraint_name] == JournalEntry.duplicate_source_file_index()
224	    end)
225	  end
226	
227	  defp conflicting_entry_id(user_id, digest) do
228	    from(je in JournalEntry,
229	      where: je.user_id == ^user_id and je.source_document_sha256 == ^digest,
230	      where: not je.source_file_reuse_confirmed,
231	      select: je.id,
232	      limit: 1
233	    )
234	    |> Repo.one()
235	  end
236	
237	  # -- Summary -----------------------------------------------------------------
238	
239	  defp empty_summary do
240	    %{
241	      documents_hashed: 0,
242	      documents_already_complete: 0,
243	      missing_objects: [],
244	      read_failures: [],
245	      entries_updated: 0,
246	      entries_already_complete: 0,
247	      entries_reuse_confirmed: [],
248	      entries_source_unavailable: [],
249	      collisions: [],
250	      unused_reuse_confirmations: []
251	    }
252	  end
253	
254	  defp finalize(summary, confirm_reuse) do
255	    applied = MapSet.new(summary.entries_reuse_confirmed)
256	
257	    %{
258	      summary
259	      | missing_objects: Enum.reverse(summary.missing_objects),
260	        read_failures: Enum.reverse(summary.read_failures),
261	        entries_reuse_confirmed: Enum.reverse(summary.entries_reuse_confirmed),
262	        entries_source_unavailable: Enum.reverse(summary.entries_source_unavailable),
263	        collisions: Enum.reverse(summary.collisions),
264	        unused_reuse_confirmations: confirm_reuse |> MapSet.difference(applied) |> Enum.sort()
265	    }
266	  end
267	
268	  defp complete?(summary) do
269	    summary.missing_objects == [] and summary.read_failures == [] and
270	      summary.entries_source_unavailable == [] and summary.collisions == []
271	  end
272	
273	  defp coverage_line(summary) do
274	    if complete?(summary),
275	      do: ["Historical fingerprint coverage is complete."],
276	      else: ["Historical fingerprint coverage is INCOMPLETE; see the rows above."]
277	  end
278	
279	  defp format_read_failure(%{document_id: id, reason: reason}),
280	    do: "Read failure for document #{id}: #{inspect(reason)}"

defmodule ZaimuTomo.Documents.FingerprintBackfill do
  @moduledoc """
  Idempotent, online backfill of exact-byte fingerprints for rows created
  before fingerprints existed.

  1. Every document with a null `content_sha256` is read through
     `ZaimuTomo.Storage` and hashed. A missing or unreadable object is
     reported and left null; no other value is ever stored in its place.
  2. Every journal entry with a null `source_document_sha256` receives its
     source document's fingerprint, one entry per update and oldest first, so
     the first posting of a file keeps it. A unique-index violation (a same-user
     historical duplicate) affects only that row: it is reported with the entry
     it collides with and left null. Ledger rows are never deleted or merged.

  A human may resolve a reported collision by listing the later entry in
  `:confirm_reuse`; the backfill then sets its digest and
  `source_file_reuse_confirmed` in one update. This is the only permitted
  update of an existing entry's fingerprint (spec D7), so it must run before
  any database-level immutability trigger on `journal_entries` exists, or that
  trigger must allow it.

  The report contains row IDs and counts only, never bytes or digests. The
  partial unique index already exists, so concurrent postings cannot create a
  same-user duplicate while this runs.
  """

  import Ecto.Query, warn: false

  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.JournalEntry
  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Document
  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Fingerprint
  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.ReviewDecision
  alias ZaimuTomo.Storage

  @type collision :: %{journal_entry_id: integer(), user_id: integer(), conflicts_with: integer()}

  @type summary :: %{
          documents_hashed: non_neg_integer(),
          documents_already_complete: non_neg_integer(),
          missing_objects: [integer()],
          read_failures: [%{document_id: integer(), reason: term()}],
          entries_updated: non_neg_integer(),
          entries_already_complete: non_neg_integer(),
          entries_reuse_confirmed: [integer()],
          entries_source_unavailable: [integer()],
          collisions: [collision()],
          unused_reuse_confirmations: [integer()]
        }

  @doc """
  Runs the backfill.

  Returns `{:ok, summary}` when historical coverage is complete, and
  `{:error, summary}` when any object is missing or unreadable, an entry's
  source fingerprint is unavailable, or a collision awaits human review.

  Options:

    * `:confirm_reuse` — journal entry IDs a human confirmed as legitimate
      reuses of an already posted file. Applied only to an entry whose plain
      update collides; otherwise reported as unused.
  """
  @spec run(keyword()) :: {:ok, summary()} | {:error, summary()}
  def run(opts \\ []) do
    confirm_reuse = opts |> Keyword.get(:confirm_reuse, []) |> MapSet.new()

    summary =
      empty_summary()
      |> backfill_documents()
      |> backfill_journal_entries(confirm_reuse)
      |> finalize(confirm_reuse)

    if complete?(summary), do: {:ok, summary}, else: {:error, summary}
  end

  @spec format_summary(summary()) :: String.t()
  def format_summary(summary) do
    [
      "Fingerprint backfill summary: " <>
        "documents_hashed=#{summary.documents_hashed} " <>
        "documents_already_complete=#{summary.documents_already_complete} " <>
        "missing_objects=#{length(summary.missing_objects)} " <>
        "read_failures=#{length(summary.read_failures)} " <>
        "entries_updated=#{summary.entries_updated} " <>
        "entries_already_complete=#{summary.entries_already_complete} " <>
        "entries_reuse_confirmed=#{length(summary.entries_reuse_confirmed)} " <>
        "entries_source_unavailable=#{length(summary.entries_source_unavailable)} " <>
        "collisions=#{length(summary.collisions)}"
      | Enum.map(summary.missing_objects, &"Missing object for document #{&1}") ++
          Enum.map(summary.read_failures, &format_read_failure/1) ++
          Enum.map(summary.entries_source_unavailable, &format_source_unavailable/1) ++
          Enum.map(summary.collisions, &format_collision/1) ++
          Enum.map(summary.entries_reuse_confirmed, &"Confirmed reuse for journal entry #{&1}") ++
          Enum.map(summary.unused_reuse_confirmations, &format_unused_confirmation/1) ++
          coverage_line(summary)
    ]
    |> Enum.join("\n")
  end

  # -- Documents ---------------------------------------------------------------

  defp backfill_documents(summary) do
    already_complete =
      Repo.aggregate(from(d in Document, where: not is_nil(d.content_sha256)), :count)

    from(d in Document,
      where: is_nil(d.content_sha256),
      order_by: [asc: d.id],
      select: {d.id, d.object_key}
    )
    |> Repo.all()
    |> Enum.reduce(%{summary | documents_already_complete: already_complete}, &hash_document/2)
  end

  defp hash_document({document_id, object_key}, summary) do
    case Storage.read_object(object_key) do
      {:ok, body} ->
        # Conditional on the same key and a still-null digest, so a concurrent
        # file replacement (which records its own digest) is never overwritten.
        {count, _} =
          from(d in Document,
            where:
              d.id == ^document_id and d.object_key == ^object_key and
                is_nil(d.content_sha256)
          )
          |> Repo.update_all(set: [content_sha256: Fingerprint.sha256(body)])

        if count == 1,
          do: %{summary | documents_hashed: summary.documents_hashed + 1},
          else: %{summary | documents_already_complete: summary.documents_already_complete + 1}

      {:error, :not_found} ->
        %{summary | missing_objects: [document_id | summary.missing_objects]}

      {:error, reason} ->
        failure = %{document_id: document_id, reason: reason}
        %{summary | read_failures: [failure | summary.read_failures]}
    end
  end

  # -- Journal entries ---------------------------------------------------------

  defp backfill_journal_entries(summary, confirm_reuse) do
    already_complete =
      Repo.aggregate(
        from(je in JournalEntry, where: not is_nil(je.source_document_sha256)),
        :count
      )

    from(je in JournalEntry,
      left_join: rd in ReviewDecision,
      on: rd.id == je.review_decision_id,
      left_join: ec in ExtractedContent,
      on: ec.id == rd.extracted_content_id and ec.user_id == je.user_id,
      left_join: d in Document,
      on: d.id == ec.document_id and d.user_id == je.user_id,
      where: is_nil(je.source_document_sha256),
      order_by: [asc: je.inserted_at, asc: je.id],
      select: {je, d.content_sha256}
    )
    |> Repo.all()
    |> Enum.reduce(
      %{summary | entries_already_complete: already_complete},
      &backfill_entry(&1, &2, confirm_reuse)
    )
  end

  defp backfill_entry({entry, nil}, summary, _confirm_reuse) do
    %{summary | entries_source_unavailable: [entry.id | summary.entries_source_unavailable]}
  end

  defp backfill_entry({entry, digest}, summary, confirm_reuse) do
    case update_entry(entry, %{source_document_sha256: digest}) do
      {:ok, _entry} ->
        %{summary | entries_updated: summary.entries_updated + 1}

      {:error, :collision} ->
        if MapSet.member?(confirm_reuse, entry.id) do
          confirm_reuse(entry, digest, summary)
        else
          collision = %{
            journal_entry_id: entry.id,
            user_id: entry.user_id,
            conflicts_with: conflicting_entry_id(entry.user_id, digest)
          }

          %{summary | collisions: [collision | summary.collisions]}
        end
    end
  end

  defp confirm_reuse(entry, digest, summary) do
    attrs = %{source_document_sha256: digest, source_file_reuse_confirmed: true}

    # A confirmed reuse is outside the partial index, so it cannot collide.
    {:ok, _entry} = update_entry(entry, attrs)
    %{summary | entries_reuse_confirmed: [entry.id | summary.entries_reuse_confirmed]}
  end

  # The fingerprint is derived metadata, not an edit: keep `updated_at`, which
  # orders the user's journal list.
  defp update_entry(entry, attrs) do
    entry
    |> JournalEntry.changeset_for_fingerprint_backfill(attrs)
    |> Ecto.Changeset.force_change(:updated_at, entry.updated_at)
    |> Repo.update()
    |> case do
      {:ok, entry} ->
        {:ok, entry}

      {:error, %Ecto.Changeset{} = changeset} ->
        if source_file_collision?(changeset),
          do: {:error, :collision},
          else: raise(Ecto.InvalidChangesetError, action: :update, changeset: changeset)
    end
  end

  defp source_file_collision?(%Ecto.Changeset{errors: errors}) do
    Enum.any?(errors, fn {_field, {_message, opts}} ->
      opts[:constraint] == :unique and
        opts[:constraint_name] == JournalEntry.duplicate_source_file_index()
    end)
  end

  defp conflicting_entry_id(user_id, digest) do
    from(je in JournalEntry,
      where: je.user_id == ^user_id and je.source_document_sha256 == ^digest,
      where: not je.source_file_reuse_confirmed,
      select: je.id,
      limit: 1
    )
    |> Repo.one()
  end

  # -- Summary -----------------------------------------------------------------

  defp empty_summary do
    %{
      documents_hashed: 0,
      documents_already_complete: 0,
      missing_objects: [],
      read_failures: [],
      entries_updated: 0,
      entries_already_complete: 0,
      entries_reuse_confirmed: [],
      entries_source_unavailable: [],
      collisions: [],
      unused_reuse_confirmations: []
    }
  end

  defp finalize(summary, confirm_reuse) do
    applied = MapSet.new(summary.entries_reuse_confirmed)

    %{
      summary
      | missing_objects: Enum.reverse(summary.missing_objects),
        read_failures: Enum.reverse(summary.read_failures),
        entries_reuse_confirmed: Enum.reverse(summary.entries_reuse_confirmed),
        entries_source_unavailable: Enum.reverse(summary.entries_source_unavailable),
        collisions: Enum.reverse(summary.collisions),
        unused_reuse_confirmations: confirm_reuse |> MapSet.difference(applied) |> Enum.sort()
    }
  end

  defp complete?(summary) do
    summary.missing_objects == [] and summary.read_failures == [] and
      summary.entries_source_unavailable == [] and summary.collisions == []
  end

  defp coverage_line(summary) do
    if complete?(summary),
      do: ["Historical fingerprint coverage is complete."],
      else: ["Historical fingerprint coverage is INCOMPLETE; see the rows above."]
  end

  defp format_read_failure(%{document_id: id, reason: reason}),
    do: "Read failure for document #{id}: #{inspect(reason)}"

  defp format_source_unavailable(id),
    do: "Journal entry #{id}: source document fingerprint unavailable"

  defp format_collision(%{journal_entry_id: id, user_id: user_id, conflicts_with: other}),
    do:
      "Collision: journal entry #{id} (user #{user_id}) has the same source file as " <>
        "entry #{other}; left null for human ledger review"

  defp format_unused_confirmation(id),
    do: "Reuse confirmation for journal entry #{id} not applied (no collision to resolve)"
end

defmodule ZaimuTomo.Accounts.Scope do
  @moduledoc """
  Defines the scope of the caller to be used throughout the app.

  The `ZaimuTomo.Accounts.Scope` allows public interfaces to receive
  information about the caller, such as if the call is initiated from an
  end-user, and if so, which user. Additionally, such a scope can carry fields
  such as "super user" or other privileges for use as authorization, or to
  ensure specific code paths can only be access for a given scope.

  It is useful for logging as well as for scoping pubsub subscriptions and
  broadcasts when a caller subscribes to an interface or performs a particular
  action.

  Feel free to extend the fields on this struct to fit the needs of
  growing application requirements.
  """

  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounts.User

  defstruct user: nil

  @type t :: %__MODULE__{}

  @doc """
  Creates a scope for the given user.

  Returns nil if no user is given.
  """
  def for_user(%User{} = user) do
    %__MODULE__{user: user}
  end

  def for_user(nil), do: nil
end

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.Accounting.LegacyBookingBackfill do
2	  @moduledoc """
3	  One-off backfill for journal entries that predate booking at posting time and
4	  are still missing a category or a need/want choice.
5	
6	  An entry is completed only when the same user's posted entries from the same
7	  issuer (compared like the duplicate index, trimmed and case-insensitive) agree
8	  on every missing value. Values the entry already has are kept. Anything else
9	  is reported for a person to book, so nothing is guessed from a similar name.
10	
11	  Bookings a person already decided are passed at run time as `:manual`, so no
12	  real ledger data lives in the repository. They are keyed by entry ID and
13	  normalized issuer so they cannot land on another row, and go through
14	  `Accounting.post_entry/6`, exactly like the invoice page's Book form.
15	
16	  It is a dry run unless called with `confirm: true`. Each entry is updated in
17	  its own transaction together with a `journal_entry_posted` event marked with
18	  `source: "legacy_booking_backfill"` that records the prior state. For those copied bookings, tax claims and notes
19	  are left alone, and `updated_at` is kept so old entries do not jump to the top
20	  of the journal.
21	  """
22	
23	  import Ecto.Query, warn: false
24	
25	  alias Ecto.Multi
26	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting
27	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.JournalEntry
28	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.TaxDeductionClaim
29	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
30	  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
31	  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.ReviewDecision
32	
33	  @source "legacy_booking_backfill"
34	
35	  @type match :: %{
36	          required(:entry) => JournalEntry.t(),
37	          required(:document_id) => integer(),
38	          required(:category) => String.t(),
39	          required(:need_or_want) => String.t(),
40	          required(:source) => :precedent | :manual,
41	          optional(:precedent_count) => pos_integer(),
42	          optional(:tax_status) => String.t() | nil
43	        }
44	
45	  @type unmatched :: %{
46	          entry: JournalEntry.t(),
47	          document_id: integer(),
48	          reason: :no_history | :conflicting_history
49	        }
50	
51	  @type summary :: %{
52	          confirmed: boolean(),
53	          matched: [match()],
54	          applied: [match()],
55	          unmatched: [unmatched()],
56	          failed: [%{match: match(), errors: term()}]
57	        }
58	
59	  @doc """
60	  Plans the backfill and, with `confirm: true`, applies it.
61	
62	  Returns `{:error, summary}` only when an update failed. Unmatched entries are
63	  expected and left for manual booking.
64	
65	  Options:
66	
67	    * `:confirm` - apply the plan instead of only reporting it.
68	    * `:manual` - decided bookings as a map of `{entry_id, normalized_issuer}`
69	      to `%{category: _, need_or_want: _, tax_status: _}`. Defaults to none.
70	  """
71	  @spec run(keyword()) :: {:ok, summary()} | {:error, summary()}
72	  def run(opts \\ []) do
73	    confirmed = Keyword.get(opts, :confirm, false)
74	    %{matched: matched, unmatched: unmatched} = plan(Keyword.get(opts, :manual, %{}))
75	    %{applied: applied, failed: failed} = apply_matches(matched, confirmed)
76	
77	    summary = %{
78	      confirmed: confirmed,
79	      matched: matched,
80	      applied: applied,
81	      unmatched: unmatched,
82	      failed: failed
83	    }
84	
85	    {if(failed == [], do: :ok, else: :error), summary}
86	  end
87	
88	  @spec format_summary(summary()) :: String.t()
89	  def format_summary(summary) do
90	    verb = if summary.confirmed, do: "Booked", else: "Would book"
91	    mode = if summary.confirmed, do: "applied", else: "dry run"
92	
93	    [
94	      "Legacy booking backfill (#{mode}): matched=#{length(summary.matched)} " <>
95	        "applied=#{length(summary.applied)} unmatched=#{length(summary.unmatched)} " <>
96	        "failed=#{length(summary.failed)}",
97	      Enum.map(summary.matched, &format_match(&1, verb)),
98	      Enum.map(summary.unmatched, &format_unmatched/1),
99	      Enum.map(summary.failed, &format_failure/1),
100	      if(summary.confirmed, do: [], else: "Nothing changed. Re-run with confirm: true to apply.")
101	    ]
102	    |> List.flatten()
103	    |> Enum.join("\n")
104	  end
105	
106	  defp plan(manual) do
107	    precedents = precedents()
108	
109	    targets()
110	    |> Enum.map(&classify(&1, precedents, manual))
111	    |> Enum.group_by(&elem(&1, 0), &elem(&1, 1))
112	    |> then(&%{matched: Map.get(&1, :matched, []), unmatched: Map.get(&1, :unmatched, [])})
113	  end
114	
115	  defp targets do
116	    Repo.all(
117	      from e in JournalEntry,
118	        join: d in ReviewDecision,
119	        on: d.id == e.review_decision_id,
120	        join: c in ExtractedContent,
121	        on: c.id == d.extracted_content_id,
122	        left_join: t in TaxDeductionClaim,
123	        on: t.journal_entry_id == e.id,
124	        where: is_nil(e.category) or is_nil(e.need_or_want),
125	        order_by: e.id,
126	        select: %{
127	          entry: e,
128	          document_id: c.document_id,
129	          tax_status: t.status,
130	          issuer_key: fragment("lower(btrim(?))", e.issuer)
131	        }
132	    )
133	  end
134	
135	  defp precedents do
136	    from(e in JournalEntry,
137	      where: e.status == "posted",
138	      where: not is_nil(e.category) and not is_nil(e.need_or_want),
139	      where: fragment("btrim(?) <> ''", e.issuer),
140	      group_by: [e.user_id, fragment("lower(btrim(?))", e.issuer), e.category, e.need_or_want],
141	      select: %{
142	        user_id: e.user_id,
143	        issuer_key: fragment("lower(btrim(?))", e.issuer),
144	        category: e.category,
145	        need_or_want: e.need_or_want,
146	        count: count(e.id)
147	      }
148	    )
149	    |> Repo.all()
150	    |> Enum.group_by(&{&1.user_id, &1.issuer_key})
151	  end
152	
153	  defp classify(%{entry: entry, issuer_key: issuer_key} = target, precedents, manual) do
154	    row = Map.take(target, [:entry, :document_id, :tax_status])
155	
156	    case Map.fetch(manual, {entry.id, issuer_key}) do
157	      {:ok, decision} -> {:matched, row |> Map.merge(decision) |> Map.put(:source, :manual)}
158	      :error -> classify_from_history(row, Map.get(precedents, {entry.user_id, issuer_key}, []))
159	    end
160	  end
161	
162	  defp classify_from_history(%{entry: entry} = row, history) do
163	    case history |> Enum.map(&completed_booking(entry, &1)) |> Enum.uniq() do
164	      [] ->
165	        {:unmatched, Map.put(row, :reason, :no_history)}
166	
167	      [{category, need_or_want}] ->
168	        precedent_count = history |> Enum.map(& &1.count) |> Enum.sum()
169	
170	        {:matched,
171	         Map.merge(row, %{
172	           category: category,
173	           need_or_want: need_or_want,
174	           precedent_count: precedent_count,
175	           source: :precedent
176	         })}
177	
178	      _conflicting ->
179	        {:unmatched, Map.put(row, :reason, :conflicting_history)}
180	    end
181	  end
182	
183	  # Precedents only need to agree on what the entry is missing.
184	  defp completed_booking(entry, precedent) do
185	    {entry.category || precedent.category, entry.need_or_want || precedent.need_or_want}
186	  end
187	
188	  defp apply_matches(_matched, false), do: %{applied: [], failed: []}
189	
190	  defp apply_matches(matched, true) do
191	    results = Enum.map(matched, &{&1, apply_match(&1)})
192	
193	    %{
194	      applied: for({match, {:ok, _}} <- results, do: match),
195	      failed:
196	        for({match, {:error, changeset}} <- results) do
197	          %{match: match, errors: changeset.errors}
198	        end
199	    }
200	  end
201	
202	  defp apply_match(%{source: :manual, entry: entry} = match) do
203	    Accounting.post_entry(
204	      entry,
205	      entry.user_id,
206	      match.category,
207	      match.need_or_want,
208	      entry.notes,
209	      %{"status" => match.tax_status}
210	    )
211	  end
212	
213	  defp apply_match(%{source: :precedent} = match) do
214	    Multi.new()
215	    |> Multi.update(:entry, booking_changeset(match))
216	    |> Multi.insert(:event, &event_changeset(&1.entry, match))
217	    |> Repo.transaction()
218	    |> case do
219	      {:ok, changes} -> {:ok, changes}
220	      {:error, _step, changeset, _changes} -> {:error, changeset}
221	    end
222	  end
223	
224	  defp booking_changeset(%{entry: entry} = match) do
225	    entry
226	    |> JournalEntry.changeset_for_categorize(%{
227	      category: match.category,
228	      need_or_want: match.need_or_want,
229	      status: "posted"
230	    })
231	    |> Ecto.Changeset.force_change(:updated_at, entry.updated_at)
232	  end
233	
234	  defp event_changeset(booked_entry, %{entry: previous} = match) do
235	    Accounting.posted_event_changeset(booked_entry, match.tax_status, %{
236	      source: @source,
237	      precedent_count: match.precedent_count,
238	      previous_status: previous.status,
239	      previous_category: previous.category,
240	      previous_need_or_want: previous.need_or_want
241	    })
242	  end
243	
244	  defp format_match(%{entry: entry} = match, verb) do
245	    "#{verb} entry #{entry.id} (#{entry.issuer}) as #{match.category} / #{match.need_or_want} " <>
246	      match_origin(match) <> "."
247	  end
248	
249	  defp match_origin(%{source: :manual, tax_status: tax_status}),
250	    do: "from a manual decision, tax status #{tax_status}"
251	
252	  defp match_origin(%{source: :precedent, precedent_count: count}),
253	    do: "from #{count} earlier posting(s)"
254	
255	  defp format_unmatched(%{entry: entry, document_id: document_id, reason: reason}) do
256	    "Book by hand: entry #{entry.id} (#{entry.issuer}) at /documents/#{document_id}: " <>
257	      unmatched_reason(reason) <> "."
258	  end
259	
260	  defp unmatched_reason(:no_history), do: "no earlier posting from this issuer"
261	  defp unmatched_reason(:conflicting_history), do: "earlier postings disagree"
262	
263	  defp format_failure(%{match: %{entry: entry}, errors: errors}) do
264	    "Failed entry #{entry.id}: #{inspect(errors)}"
265	  end
266	end
267

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.Documents.FingerprintBackfill do
2	  @moduledoc """
3	  Idempotent, online backfill of exact-byte fingerprints for rows created
4	  before fingerprints existed.
5	
6	  1. Every document with a null `content_sha256` is read through
7	     `ZaimuTomo.Storage` and hashed. A missing or unreadable object is
8	     reported and left null; no other value is ever stored in its place.
9	  2. Every journal entry with a null `source_document_sha256` receives its
10	     source document's fingerprint, one entry per update and oldest first, so
11	     the first posting of a file keeps it. A unique-index violation (a same-user
12	     historical duplicate) affects only that row: it is reported with the entry
13	     it collides with and left null. Ledger rows are never deleted or merged.
14	
15	  A human may resolve a reported collision by listing the later entry in
16	  `:confirm_reuse`; the backfill then sets its digest and
17	  `source_file_reuse_confirmed` in one update. This is the only permitted
18	  update of an existing entry's fingerprint (spec D7), so it must run before
19	  any database-level immutability trigger on `journal_entries` exists, or that
20	  trigger must allow it.
21	
22	  The report contains row IDs and counts only, never bytes or digests. The
23	  partial unique index already exists, so concurrent postings cannot create a
24	  same-user duplicate while this runs.
25	  """
26	
27	  import Ecto.Query, warn: false
28	
29	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.JournalEntry
30	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
31	  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Document
32	  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Fingerprint
33	  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
34	  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.ReviewDecision
35	  alias ZaimuTomo.Storage
36	
37	  @type collision :: %{journal_entry_id: integer(), user_id: integer(), conflicts_with: integer()}
38	
39	  @type summary :: %{
40	          documents_hashed: non_neg_integer(),
41	          documents_already_complete: non_neg_integer(),
42	          missing_objects: [integer()],
43	          read_failures: [%{document_id: integer(), reason: term()}],
44	          entries_updated: non_neg_integer(),
45	          entries_already_complete: non_neg_integer(),
46	          entries_reuse_confirmed: [integer()],
47	          entries_source_unavailable: [integer()],
48	          collisions: [collision()],
49	          unused_reuse_confirmations: [integer()]
50	        }
51	
52	  @doc """
53	  Runs the backfill.
54	
55	  Returns `{:ok, summary}` when historical coverage is complete, and
56	  `{:error, summary}` when any object is missing or unreadable, an entry's
57	  source fingerprint is unavailable, or a collision awaits human review.
58	
59	  Options:
60	
61	    * `:confirm_reuse` — journal entry IDs a human confirmed as legitimate
62	      reuses of an already posted file. Applied only to an entry whose plain
63	      update collides; otherwise reported as unused.
64	  """
65	  @spec run(keyword()) :: {:ok, summary()} | {:error, summary()}
66	  def run(opts \\ []) do
67	    confirm_reuse = opts |> Keyword.get(:confirm_reuse, []) |> MapSet.new()
68	
69	    summary =
70	      empty_summary()
71	      |> backfill_documents()
72	      |> backfill_journal_entries(confirm_reuse)
73	      |> finalize(confirm_reuse)
74	
75	    if complete?(summary), do: {:ok, summary}, else: {:error, summary}
76	  end
77	
78	  @spec format_summary(summary()) :: String.t()
79	  def format_summary(summary) do
80	    [
81	      "Fingerprint backfill summary: " <>
82	        "documents_hashed=#{summary.documents_hashed} " <>
83	        "documents_already_complete=#{summary.documents_already_complete} " <>
84	        "missing_objects=#{length(summary.missing_objects)} " <>
85	        "read_failures=#{length(summary.read_failures)} " <>
86	        "entries_updated=#{summary.entries_updated} " <>
87	        "entries_already_complete=#{summary.entries_already_complete} " <>
88	        "entries_reuse_confirmed=#{length(summary.entries_reuse_confirmed)} " <>
89	        "entries_source_unavailable=#{length(summary.entries_source_unavailable)} " <>
90	        "collisions=#{length(summary.collisions)}"
91	      | Enum.map(summary.missing_objects, &"Missing object for document #{&1}") ++
92	          Enum.map(summary.read_failures, &format_read_failure/1) ++
93	          Enum.map(summary.entries_source_unavailable, &format_source_unavailable/1) ++
94	          Enum.map(summary.collisions, &format_collision/1) ++
95	          Enum.map(summary.entries_reuse_confirmed, &"Confirmed reuse for journal entry #{&1}") ++
96	          Enum.map(summary.unused_reuse_confirmations, &format_unused_confirmation/1) ++
97	          coverage_line(summary)
98	    ]
99	    |> Enum.join("\n")
100	  end
101	
102	  # -- Documents ---------------------------------------------------------------
103	
104	  defp backfill_documents(summary) do
105	    already_complete =
106	      Repo.aggregate(from(d in Document, where: not is_nil(d.content_sha256)), :count)
107	
108	    from(d in Document,
109	      where: is_nil(d.content_sha256),
110	      order_by: [asc: d.id],
111	      select: {d.id, d.object_key}
112	    )
113	    |> Repo.all()
114	    |> Enum.reduce(%{summary | documents_already_complete: already_complete}, &hash_document/2)
115	  end
116	
117	  defp hash_document({document_id, object_key}, summary) do
118	    case Storage.read_object(object_key) do
119	      {:ok, body} ->
120	        # Conditional on the same key and a still-null digest, so a concurrent
121	        # file replacement (which records its own digest) is never overwritten.
122	        {count, _} =
123	          from(d in Document,
124	            where:
125	              d.id == ^document_id and d.object_key == ^object_key and
126	                is_nil(d.content_sha256)
127	          )
128	          |> Repo.update_all(set: [content_sha256: Fingerprint.sha256(body)])
129	
130	        if count == 1,
131	          do: %{summary | documents_hashed: summary.documents_hashed + 1},
132	          else: %{summary | documents_already_complete: summary.documents_already_complete + 1}
133	
134	      {:error, :not_found} ->
135	        %{summary | missing_objects: [document_id | summary.missing_objects]}
136	
137	      {:error, reason} ->
138	        failure = %{document_id: document_id, reason: reason}
139	        %{summary | read_failures: [failure | summary.read_failures]}
140	    end
141	  end
142	
143	  # -- Journal entries ---------------------------------------------------------
144	
145	  defp backfill_journal_entries(summary, confirm_reuse) do
146	    already_complete =
147	      Repo.aggregate(
148	        from(je in JournalEntry, where: not is_nil(je.source_document_sha256)),
149	        :count
150	      )
151	
152	    from(je in JournalEntry,
153	      left_join: rd in ReviewDecision,
154	      on: rd.id == je.review_decision_id,
155	      left_join: ec in ExtractedContent,
156	      on: ec.id == rd.extracted_content_id and ec.user_id == je.user_id,
157	      left_join: d in Document,
158	      on: d.id == ec.document_id and d.user_id == je.user_id,
159	      where: is_nil(je.source_document_sha256),
160	      order_by: [asc: je.inserted_at, asc: je.id],
161	      select: {je, d.content_sha256}
162	    )
163	    |> Repo.all()
164	    |> Enum.reduce(
165	      %{summary | entries_already_complete: already_complete},
166	      &backfill_entry(&1, &2, confirm_reuse)
167	    )
168	  end
169	
170	  defp backfill_entry({entry, nil}, summary, _confirm_reuse) do
171	    %{summary | entries_source_unavailable: [entry.id | summary.entries_source_unavailable]}
172	  end
173	
174	  defp backfill_entry({entry, digest}, summary, confirm_reuse) do
175	    case update_entry(entry, %{source_document_sha256: digest}) do
176	      {:ok, _entry} ->
177	        %{summary | entries_updated: summary.entries_updated + 1}
178	
179	      {:error, :collision} ->
180	        if MapSet.member?(confirm_reuse, entry.id) do
181	          confirm_reuse(entry, digest, summary)
182	        else
183	          collision = %{
184	            journal_entry_id: entry.id,
185	            user_id: entry.user_id,
186	            conflicts_with: conflicting_entry_id(entry.user_id, digest)
187	          }
188	
189	          %{summary | collisions: [collision | summary.collisions]}
190	        end
191	    end
192	  end
193	
194	  defp confirm_reuse(entry, digest, summary) do
195	    attrs = %{source_document_sha256: digest, source_file_reuse_confirmed: true}
196	
197	    # A confirmed reuse is outside the partial index, so it cannot collide.
198	    {:ok, _entry} = update_entry(entry, attrs)
199	    %{summary | entries_reuse_confirmed: [entry.id | summary.entries_reuse_confirmed]}
200	  end
201	
202	  # The fingerprint is derived metadata, not an edit: keep `updated_at`, which
203	  # orders the user's journal list.
204	  defp update_entry(entry, attrs) do
205	    entry
206	    |> JournalEntry.changeset_for_fingerprint_backfill(attrs)
207	    |> Ecto.Changeset.force_change(:updated_at, entry.updated_at)
208	    |> Repo.update()
209	    |> case do
210	      {:ok, entry} ->
211	        {:ok, entry}
212	
213	      {:error, %Ecto.Changeset{} = changeset} ->
214	        if source_file_collision?(changeset),
215	          do: {:error, :collision},
216	          else: raise(Ecto.InvalidChangesetError, action: :update, changeset: changeset)
217	    end
218	  end
219	
220	  defp source_file_collision?(%Ecto.Changeset{errors: errors}) do
221	    Enum.any?(errors, fn {_field, {_message, opts}} ->
222	      opts[:constraint] == :unique and
223	        opts[:constraint_name] == JournalEntry.duplicate_source_file_index()
224	    end)
225	  end
226	
227	  defp conflicting_entry_id(user_id, digest) do
228	    from(je in JournalEntry,
229	      where: je.user_id == ^user_id and je.source_document_sha256 == ^digest,
230	      where: not je.source_file_reuse_confirmed,
231	      select: je.id,
232	      limit: 1
233	    )
234	    |> Repo.one()
235	  end
236	
237	  # -- Summary -----------------------------------------------------------------
238	
239	  defp empty_summary do
240	    %{
241	      documents_hashed: 0,
242	      documents_already_complete: 0,
243	      missing_objects: [],
244	      read_failures: [],
245	      entries_updated: 0,
246	      entries_already_complete: 0,
247	      entries_reuse_confirmed: [],
248	      entries_source_unavailable: [],
249	      collisions: [],
250	      unused_reuse_confirmations: []
251	    }
252	  end
253	
254	  defp finalize(summary, confirm_reuse) do
255	    applied = MapSet.new(summary.entries_reuse_confirmed)
256	
257	    %{
258	      summary
259	      | missing_objects: Enum.reverse(summary.missing_objects),
260	        read_failures: Enum.reverse(summary.read_failures),
261	        entries_reuse_confirmed: Enum.reverse(summary.entries_reuse_confirmed),
262	        entries_source_unavailable: Enum.reverse(summary.entries_source_unavailable),
263	        collisions: Enum.reverse(summary.collisions),
264	        unused_reuse_confirmations: confirm_reuse |> MapSet.difference(applied) |> Enum.sort()
265	    }
266	  end
267	
268	  defp complete?(summary) do
269	    summary.missing_objects == [] and summary.read_failures == [] and
270	      summary.entries_source_unavailable == [] and summary.collisions == []
271	  end
272	
273	  defp coverage_line(summary) do
274	    if complete?(summary),
275	      do: ["Historical fingerprint coverage is complete."],
276	      else: ["Historical fingerprint coverage is INCOMPLETE; see the rows above."]
277	  end
278	
279	  defp format_read_failure(%{document_id: id, reason: reason}),
280	    do: "Read failure for document #{id}: #{inspect(reason)}"
281	
282	  defp format_source_unavailable(id),
283	    do: "Journal entry #{id}: source document fingerprint unavailable"
284	
285	  defp format_collision(%{journal_entry_id: id, user_id: user_id, conflicts_with: other}),
286	    do:
287	      "Collision: journal entry #{id} (user #{user_id}) has the same source file as " <>
288	        "entry #{other}; left null for human ledger review"
289	
290	  defp format_unused_confirmation(id),
291	    do: "Reuse confirmation for journal entry #{id} not applied (no collision to resolve)"
292	end

  @doc """
  True when a journal-entry insert failed on the unique
  (user, issuer, invoice number) index or the unique (user, source file
  digest) index over unconfirmed postings.

  Matches the constraint name rather than the error message, so unrelated
  changeset errors are never mistaken for a duplicate.
  """
  @spec duplicate_error?(Ecto.Changeset.t()) :: boolean()
  def duplicate_error?(%Ecto.Changeset{errors: errors}) do
    duplicate_indexes = [
      JournalEntry.duplicate_invoice_index(),
      JournalEntry.duplicate_source_file_index()
    ]

    Enum.any?(errors, fn {_field, {_message, opts}} ->
      opts[:constraint] == :unique and opts[:constraint_name] in duplicate_indexes
    end)
  end

  def duplicate_error?(_other), do: false

367	## 9. Architecture decisions
368	
369	Short decision records, newest last. Add one when a change alters structure,
370	infrastructure, or a cross-cutting rule. Older, longer feature-level reasoning
371	is in [`specs/`](../specs/README.md).
372	
373	| # | Date | Decision | Why / consequences |
374	|---|---|---|---|
375	| D1 | 2026-01 | Phoenix LiveView monolith with phx.gen.auth scopes | One deployable, server-rendered real-time UI. All data is scoped per user. |
376	| D2 | 2026-03 | Persist every extraction attempt as a row; one review decision per extraction | Keeps history, and humans approve before booking. See `specs/001`, `specs/002`. |
377	| D3 | 2026-05 | Journal entries only from approved or amended decisions | AI never writes to the books directly. |
378	| D4 | 2026-06 | Kamal 2 on a single VPS, app reachable only over WireGuard | Low cost, private by default. Postgres runs as a Kamal accessory. |
379	| D5 | 2026-08 | Per-role LLM backends (extractor and verifier) selected by env, with no fallback | Models can be swapped or mixed (local and cloud) without code changes. Misconfiguration fails loudly. |
380	| D6 | 2026-08 | Document bytes in S3-compatible storage (self-hosted RustFS), with a provider-neutral `Storage` facade | Decouples bytes from the release. A later provider switch is config only. See `specs/003`. |
381	| D7 | 2026-09 | TypeSafe Jev as a *shadow* verifier | Collects independent per-field error probabilities without affecting outcomes until it is trusted. |
382	| D8 | 2026-09 | Replace fire-and-forget `Task` OCR with durable Oban jobs, enqueued in the upload transaction | Uploads can't lose their job. Retries, Lifeline rescue, user retry, and operator recovery. The TypeSafe shadow also moved to Oban. |
383	| D9 | 2026-10 | Add `stream_data` (test-only) for property-based tests on pure, boundary-heavy logic (currency normalization, error-retry classification, changeset validity, aggregation sums) | Generates and shrinks adversarial inputs instead of relying only on hand-picked examples; already caught an Ecto blank-string edge case in `Currency.normalize_and_validate/2`. DB-backed properties cap `max_runs` explicitly to bound CI time; `config :stream_data, max_runs` is lower locally, higher in CI (`CI=true`, set by GitHub Actions by default). |
384	| D10 | 2026-08 | Duplicate invoice detection: DB-enforced unique index, plus the journal entry in the same transaction as the review decision | A numbered invoice (same user, issuer, invoice number) cannot post twice; the database enforces it regardless of code path. An unnumbered exact `(issuer, date, amount, currency)` match warns and needs explicit confirmation. Posting the journal entry, tax claim, and event log now happens in the same `Ecto.Multi` as the decision update, so a duplicate or a failed audit write rolls the whole transition back — closing the gap in §11. |
385	| D11 | 2026-10 | Exact-byte SHA-256 fingerprints as an OCR-independent duplicate signal, copied to the journal entry at posting and enforced by a per-user partial unique index over unconfirmed postings | Re-uploading identical bytes is caught even when OCR/LLM reads different fields. A unique constraint cannot span document → extraction → review → entry, so the digest is snapshotted on the entry. Legitimately reused files (QR-bills, standing slips) post only with an explicit per-posting confirmation, recorded on the entry and in the event log. Legacy rows are filled by an online, idempotent backfill through the `Storage` facade, never by a migration. See `specs/004`. |
386	| D12 | 2026-10 | Upgrade to Elixir 1.20 (OTP unchanged at 28) | Elixir 1.20 completes zero-annotation type inference across all constructs, so the existing `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` CI gate now also catches unreachable clauses and dead code for free, no specs or Dialyzer required. Surfaced and removed 3 pre-existing dead branches (`review.ex`, `llm_client.ex`, `langfuse.ex`) that the 1.19 compiler couldn't see. First step toward the CI reliability work tracked for direct-to-main pushes; a complementary nightly Dialyzer job (whole-program success typing) is still planned separately. |
387	| D13 | 2026-10 | Split CI into `lint` / `test` / `security-audit` jobs; `mix credo --strict` and `mix hex.audit` run on every push but are advisory (non-blocking), with a separate nightly workflow re-running the audit so a CVE disclosed on a quiet day still gets caught | First step of hardening CI as the real safety net for pushing straight to `main` with less manual review. Credo and the audit aren't required checks yet because both already have a pre-existing backlog (51 Credo issues; `hackney` pinned to a vulnerable 1.x line by a test-only dependency) unrelated to any one change — see §11. `mix hex.audit` found 6 live advisories in locked dependencies; the `bandit` ones were fixed by a routine version bump in the same change, `hackney`'s needs a dependency change tracked separately. |

## 9. Architecture decisions

Short decision records, newest last. Add one when a change alters structure,
infrastructure, or a cross-cutting rule. Older, longer feature-level reasoning
is in [`specs/`](../specs/README.md).

| # | Date | Decision | Why / consequences |
|---|---|---|---|
| D1 | 2026-01 | Phoenix LiveView monolith with phx.gen.auth scopes | One deployable, server-rendered real-time UI. All data is scoped per user. |
| D2 | 2026-03 | Persist every extraction attempt as a row; one review decision per extraction | Keeps history, and humans approve before booking. See `specs/001`, `specs/002`. |
| D3 | 2026-05 | Journal entries only from approved or amended decisions | AI never writes to the books directly. |
| D4 | 2026-06 | Kamal 2 on a single VPS, app reachable only over WireGuard | Low cost, private by default. Postgres runs as a Kamal accessory. |
| D5 | 2026-08 | Per-role LLM backends (extractor and verifier) selected by env, with no fallback | Models can be swapped or mixed (local and cloud) without code changes. Misconfiguration fails loudly. |
| D6 | 2026-08 | Document bytes in S3-compatible storage (self-hosted RustFS), with a provider-neutral `Storage` facade | Decouples bytes from the release. A later provider switch is config only. See `specs/003`. |
| D7 | 2026-09 | TypeSafe Jev as a *shadow* verifier | Collects independent per-field error probabilities without affecting outcomes until it is trusted. |
| D8 | 2026-09 | Replace fire-and-forget `Task` OCR with durable Oban jobs, enqueued in the upload transaction | Uploads can't lose their job. Retries, Lifeline rescue, user retry, and operator recovery. The TypeSafe shadow also moved to Oban. |
| D9 | 2026-10 | Add `stream_data` (test-only) for property-based tests on pure, boundary-heavy logic (currency normalization, error-retry classification, changeset validity, aggregation sums) | Generates and shrinks adversarial inputs instead of relying only on hand-picked examples; already caught an Ecto blank-string edge case in `Currency.normalize_and_validate/2`. DB-backed properties cap `max_runs` explicitly to bound CI time; `config :stream_data, max_runs` is lower locally, higher in CI (`CI=true`, set by GitHub Actions by default). |

defp event_topic(user_id, kind), do: "user:#{user_id}:document_processing:#{kind}"

  @doc """
  Builds the OCR job changeset for a document.

  The command is self-contained and resolved at enqueue time: the document id,
  a queue-time snapshot of the owner's base currency (`currency_hint`), and the
  latest extraction id to supersede (or `nil` when there is none). The worker
  pattern-matches this command and never queries Accounts.
  """
  def ocr_job(%Document{} = document, currency_hint, supersedes_extraction_id) do
    OCRJob.new(%{
      document_id: document.id,
      currency_hint: currency_hint,
      supersedes_extraction_id: supersedes_extraction_id
    })
  end

  @doc """
  Returns the processing state of a document.
  """
  @spec processing_state(Document.t()) :: processing_state()
  def processing_state(%Document{} = document) do
    latest = ExtractedContentContext.get_latest_by_document(document.id)
    classify_state(live_job?(document.id), latest)
  end

  @doc """
  Returns the processing state of many documents at once.

  Same semantics as `processing_state/1`, but resolved with two queries
  (live jobs and latest extraction per document) regardless of how many ids are
  given. Use it wherever a list of documents needs their current state.
  """
  @spec processing_states([pos_integer()]) :: %{pos_integer() => processing_state()}
  def processing_states([]), do: %{}

  def processing_states(document_ids) when is_list(document_ids) do
    live_ids =
      live_jobs()
      |> where(
        [j],
        fragment("?->>'document_id'", j.args) in ^Enum.map(document_ids, &to_string/1)
      )
      |> select([j], fragment("?->>'document_id'", j.args))
      |> Repo.all()
      |> MapSet.new()

    latest_statuses =
      ExtractedContent
      |> where([ec], ec.document_id in ^document_ids)
      |> distinct([ec], ec.document_id)
      |> order_by([ec], asc: ec.document_id, desc: ec.inserted_at, desc: ec.id)
      |> select([ec], {ec.document_id, ec.status})
      |> Repo.all()
      |> Map.new()

    Map.new(document_ids, fn id ->
      latest = latest_statuses[id] && %{status: latest_statuses[id]}
      {id, classify_state(MapSet.member?(live_ids, to_string(id)), latest)}
    end)
  end

  defp classify_state(true, _latest), do: :processing
  defp classify_state(false, nil), do: :stuck
  defp classify_state(false, %{status: "failed"}), do: :failed
  defp classify_state(false, %{status: "success"}), do: :extracted

  @doc """
  Retries processing for a document whose latest run failed or stalled.

  The document must be a persisted struct obtained through a scoped getter
  (e.g. `ZaimuTomo.Documents.get_document!/2`), matching the trust model of
  `ZaimuTomo.Documents.update_document/3`.
  Scope-checked: a document owned by another user returns `{:error, :not_found}`.
  Only `:failed` and `:stuck` are retryable; any other state returns
  `{:error, {:not_retryable, state}}`. The enqueue carries the latest extraction
  id as `supersedes_extraction_id` (nil when stuck), and failed rows are kept as
  history — the new run appends a row. An Oban uniqueness conflict counts as
  success: at most one live job can exist per document.
  """
  @spec retry_document(Scope.t(), Document.t()) ::
          {:ok, Oban.Job.t()} | {:error, :not_found | {:not_retryable, processing_state()}}
  def retry_document(%Scope{user: %{id: user_id}} = scope, %Document{user_id: user_id} = document) do
    latest = ExtractedContentContext.get_latest_by_document(document.id)

    case classify_state(live_job?(document.id), latest) do
      state when state in [:failed, :stuck] ->
        with {:ok, job} <-
               document
               |> ocr_job(scope.user.base_currency, latest && latest.id)
               |> Oban.insert() do
          # Lets open Index / hero views pick up the new live run without a reload.
          broadcast_event(:retried, user_id, %{document_id: document.id, user_id: user_id})
          {:ok, job}
        end

      state ->
        {:error, {:not_retryable, state}}
    end
  end

  def retry_document(%Scope{}, %Document{}), do: {:error, :not_found}

  @doc """
